title: The EpisodeAbout Mughal's Attack (On Banda Singh's Fort)

blocks.text: Dohra:

After the slaughtering of Banda Singh's troops roaming outside, The Mughals felt extremely proud (of their brave deed). Now they resolved to launch an attack and capture Banda Singh's fort, Since there was no reason to sit silent on their laurels. (1)
lines: After the slaughtering of Banda Singh's troops roaming outside,
The Mughals felt extremely proud (of their brave deed).
Now they resolved to launch an attack and capture Banda Singh's fort,
Since there was no reason to sit silent on their laurels.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

Then the Nawab (of Lahore) got a (long) staircase fabricated, As well as picked up several other step ladders from the countryside. Then he distributed sufficient arms and ammunition to his troops, And positioned canons and guns (around Banda Singh's fort). (2)
lines: Then the Nawab (of Lahore) got a (long) staircase fabricated,
As well as picked up several other step ladders from the countryside.
Then he distributed sufficient arms and ammunition to his troops,
And positioned canons and guns (around Banda Singh's fort).

blocks.text: The Mughal troops promised to capture Banda Singh's fort in an instant, Provided they were allowed to keep whatever they laid their hands on. Since the majority of Banda Singh's troops had been slaughtered, Only a fraction of them were lying famished and exhausted inside. (3)
lines: The Mughal troops promised to capture Banda Singh's fort in an instant,
Provided they were allowed to keep whatever they laid their hands on.
Since the majority of Banda Singh's troops had been slaughtered,
Only a fraction of them were lying famished and exhausted inside.

blocks.text: Tat Khalsa Singhs who had been truly great Singh warriors, Had already deserted Banda Singh's camp, as good luck would have it. Wherever Banda Singh fought any battle without their support, He could not face the Mughals and had to beat a retreat. (4)
lines: Tat Khalsa Singhs who had been truly great Singh warriors,
Had already deserted Banda Singh's camp, as good luck would have it.
Wherever Banda Singh fought any battle without their support,
He could not face the Mughals and had to beat a retreat.

blocks.text: Dohra:

After the slaughter of his troops who had gone out to collect provisions, Banda Singh had lost his power to perform miracles. Now they would surely capture Banda Singh (easily), And slaughter him after giving him a good fight. (5)
lines: After the slaughter of his troops who had gone out to collect provisions,
Banda Singh had lost his power to perform miracles.
Now they would surely capture Banda Singh (easily),
And slaughter him after giving him a good fight.

blocks.text: Chaupai:
As the Mughals launched an attack after this resolution, The Singhs (inside the fort) also got informed about this attack.
The Singhs accepted this challenge in the same spirit, And became mentally prepared to make a supreme sacrifice. (6)
lines: The Singhs accepted this challenge in the same spirit,
And became mentally prepared to make a supreme sacrifice.

blocks.text: Dohra:

The Singhs preferred to sacrifice their lives for the sake of Banda Singh,. Instead of dying in vain while starving inside the beseiged fort. (So) they stood in readiness with their swords (to face the enemy), After throwing open the gates of their own fort voluntarily. (7)
lines: The Singhs preferred to sacrifice their lives for the sake of Banda Singh,.
Instead of dying in vain while starving inside the beseiged fort.
(So) they stood in readiness with their swords (to face the enemy),
After throwing open the gates of their own fort voluntarily.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

A multitude of Mughal troops mounted on horses invaded the fort, Preceded by a large body of foot soldiers in the front. Expecting that Banda Singh had amassed a huge treasure inside, Only the early birds expected to lay his hands on this booty. (8)
lines: A multitude of Mughal troops mounted on horses invaded the fort,
Preceded by a large body of foot soldiers in the front.
Expecting that Banda Singh had amassed a huge treasure inside,
Only the early birds expected to lay his hands on this booty.

blocks.text: So they rushed against each other (in this mad race for this treasure), As each horse mounted soldier attempted to crush his rival. They clashed against each other and fell down in this melee. As every soldier in the rear trampled upon the one in front. (9)
lines: So they rushed against each other (in this mad race for this treasure),
As each horse mounted soldier attempted to crush his rival.
They clashed against each other and fell down in this melee.
As every soldier in the rear trampled upon the one in front.

blocks.text: In this dark and din environment of dust and smoke, The Mughal troops laid a siege around Banda Singh's fort. While the Mughal troops were reported to be four lakhs in number, The total strength of Banda Singh's troops was four thousand Singhs. (10)
lines: In this dark and din environment of dust and smoke,
The Mughal troops laid a siege around Banda Singh's fort.
While the Mughal troops were reported to be four lakhs in number,
The total strength of Banda Singh's troops was four thousand Singhs.

blocks.text: Since they had ben going without food and sleep (for many days), There was no energy left in their famished and somnolent bodies. But they felt a sudden spark of energy running through them, As who could scrutinise what was the Will of Divine? (11)
lines: Since they had ben going without food and sleep (for many days),
There was no energy left in their famished and somnolent bodies.
But they felt a sudden spark of energy running through them,
As who could scrutinise what was the Will of Divine?

blocks.text: Dohra:

Each one of the Singhs rushed ahead of each other, So keen were they to offer themselves for sacrifice. Whatever weapon they could lay their hands on, They picked up and stood up quickly (to face the enemy). (12)
lines: Each one of the Singhs rushed ahead of each other,
So keen were they to offer themselves for sacrifice.
Whatever weapon they could lay their hands on,
They picked up and stood up quickly (to face the enemy).

blocks.text: Chaupai:

As the Mughal forces launched an attack from outside, The Singhs blocked their advance from inside. (But) the Mughal forces almost arrived at the fort's gates, While shouting slogans of capturing and killing the Singhs. (13)
lines: As the Mughal forces launched an attack from outside,
The Singhs blocked their advance from inside.
(But) the Mughal forces almost arrived at the fort's gates,
While shouting slogans of capturing and killing the Singhs.

blocks.text: As the Mughal soldiers shouted the (Islamic) slogans of "Ali Ali", The Singhs shouted Guru's slogan of victory from their side. Despite the wielding of weapons by the Mughals against Singhs, The Singhs did not budge an inch from their positions. (14)
lines: As the Mughal soldiers shouted the (Islamic) slogans of "Ali Ali",
The Singhs shouted Guru's slogan of victory from their side.
Despite the wielding of weapons by the Mughals against Singhs,
The Singhs did not budge an inch from their positions.

blocks.text: The Singhs had already loaded their muskets with ammunition, By inserting two bullets in the chambers of each musket. The Singhs thought it prudent to fire those loaded muskets, As they would never face a more critical moment than the present one. (15)
lines: The Singhs had already loaded their muskets with ammunition,
By inserting two bullets in the chambers of each musket.
The Singhs thought it prudent to fire those loaded muskets,
As they would never face a more critical moment than the present one.

blocks.text: (So) they fired their muskets by placing these on their shoulders, And killed one or two Mughal soldiers with each shot. Each bullet hit a second soldier after piercing through the first person, As it had torn through this bones and flesh. (16)
lines: (So) they fired their muskets by placing these on their shoulders,
And killed one or two Mughal soldiers with each shot.
Each bullet hit a second soldier after piercing through the first person,
As it had torn through this bones and flesh.

blocks.text: Dohra:

The Mughal troops who formed the vanguard of this attack, Majority of them were shot down (by the Singhs' bullets). As the corpses of Mughal troops lay piled upon each other, Even the horses felt reluctant to walk over their bodies. (17)
lines: The Mughal troops who formed the vanguard of this attack,
Majority of them were shot down (by the Singhs' bullets).
As the corpses of Mughal troops lay piled upon each other,
Even the horses felt reluctant to walk over their bodies.
